scripts.precommit: bun run check && turbo run check-types --filter='...[HEAD]' --filter='!./apps/*'
scripts.release:changeset: bun run build && bun run publish-packages && changeset tag
scripts.publish-packages: bun run publish-package:extensions && bun run publish-package:html-studio && bun run publish-package:email
scripts.publish-package:extensions: cd packages/extensions && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && npm publish "$tgz" && rm -f "$tgz"
scripts.verify-pack: bun run verify-pack:extensions && bun run verify-pack:html-studio && bun run verify-pack:email
scripts.verify-pack:extensions: bun run build --filter=@xmazu/openenvxee-extensions && cd packages/extensions && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/extensions ($tgz)" && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const exp=d.exports?.['.']; const def=typeof exp==='string'?exp:exp?.default; if(!def?.includes('dist/')){console.error('Published export must point at dist, got:',exp);process.exit(1)} if(!d.exports?.['./protocol']){console.error('missing ./protocol export');process.exit(1)} if(!d.files?.includes('dist')){console.error('files must include dist');process.exit(1)} console.log('extensions pack ok')" && rm -f *.tgz
scripts.verify-pack:html-studio: bun run build --filter=@xmazu/openenvxee-html-studio && cd packages/openenvxee-html-studio && bun pm pack --ignore-scripts && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/openenvxee-html-studio ($tgz)" && if tar -tzf "$tgz" | grep -E '\.map$'; then echo 'ERROR: release tarball must not include sourcemaps'; exit 1; fi && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const exp=d.exports?.['.']; const def=typeof exp==='string'?exp:exp?.default; if(!def?.includes('dist/')){console.error('Published export must point at dist, got:',exp);process.exit(1)} if(!d.exports?.['./runtime']){console.error('missing ./runtime export');process.exit(1)} if(!d.files?.includes('dist')){console.error('files must include dist');process.exit(1)} const deps=d.dependencies??{}; const bad=Object.entries(deps).filter(([k,v])=>k.startsWith('@openenvx/')||String(v).startsWith('workspace:')||String(v).startsWith('catalog:')); if(bad.length){console.error('Bad runtime deps:',Object.fromEntries(bad)); process.exit(1)} console.log('html-studio pack ok, default export:',def)" && rm -f *.tgz
scripts.verify-pack:email: bun run build --filter=@openenvx/email && cd packages/email && bun pm pack --ignore-scripts && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/email ($tgz)" && if tar -tzf "$tgz" | grep -E '\.map$'; then echo 'ERROR: release tarball must not include sourcemaps'; exit 1; fi && if ! tar -tzf "$tgz" | grep -q 'package/dist/runtime.js'; then echo 'ERROR: missing dist/runtime.js'; exit 1; fi && if ! tar -tzf "$tgz" | grep -q 'package/dist/index.css'; then echo 'ERROR: missing dist/index.css'; exit 1; fi && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const exp=d.exports?.['.']; const def=typeof exp==='string'?exp:exp?.default; if(!def?.includes('dist/')){console.error('Published export must point at dist, got:',exp);process.exit(1)} if(!d.exports?.['./theme.css']){console.error('missing ./theme.css export');process.exit(1)} if(!d.exports?.['./runtime']){console.error('missing ./runtime export');process.exit(1)} if(!d.files?.includes('dist')){console.error('files must include dist');process.exit(1)} const deps=d.dependencies??{}; const bad=Object.entries(deps).filter(([k,v])=>k.startsWith('@openenvx/')&&k!=='@openenvx/email'||String(v).startsWith('workspace:')||String(v).startsWith('catalog:')); if(bad.length){console.error('Bad runtime deps:',Object.fromEntries(bad)); process.exit(1)} console.log('email pack ok, default export:',def)" && rm -f *.tgz
scripts.dev:email-package: bun run build --filter=@openenvx/email && turbo run dev --filter=@openenvxee/email-package-demo
